structured_requirements.final_statement: The system escalates the alert to the duty physician if the patient does not show a clinical response to the medication within 10 minutes, where the escalation occurs if the condition is not met at any point up to and including the 10-minute mark from the moment of administration.
structuring_notes: AMB-01 resolved: 'If she does not respond' replaced with 'if the patient does not show a clinical response to the medication' per supported interpretation.
AMB-02 resolved: 'within 10 minutes' expanded to 'if the condition is not met at any point up to and including the 10-minute mark from the moment of administration' per supported interpretation.
